title: Three market-context ML decision models live on real money ASAP: (1) ENTRY (take a long/short now or not, over a designated horizon), (2) BRACKETS (SL/TP at entry), (3) MANAGE (hold / adjust bracket / close at each check-in). One model per question pooled across symbols, not one per symbol; not tied to a strategy and not grading a strategy's decisions; NO position sizing (RiskManager owns it)
note: OPERATOR 2026-11-01 ~07:40Z (chat to Manager Session 2026-11-01a), verbatim excerpts: "I want to make sure that we are focused on getting MLs that are decision makers live ... models that don't choose like entries and then make decisions for like brackets and then either a hold, adjust, or close decision ... Let's break it down to those first stages. No position sizing. We keep on defaulting to that. We already have a risk manager." / "preferably not having like one model for each specific symbol, but rather like one model for like each question that also like shouldn't be based on like just one strategy and like grading the strategy's decisions. It should like be freely making decisions based on a market context over like designated time periods." / "I want that live on real money as soon as possible.
